name: IC Memory — 5V, SPI, 2.5V — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount memory IC cluster featuring SPI interface and 5V or 2.5V facets in TSSOP-8 package footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring surface-mount memory ICs with SPI interface support.
Use when a TSSOP-8 footprint (4.4x3mm, 0.65mm pitch) is specified.
Verify operating voltage facets (5V or 2.5V) match application requirements.
avoid_when: Avoid if the design requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
Do not use if a package family other than TSSOP is required.
Avoid when the SPI bus or specified voltage facets are incompatible.
